description: For shared numbered-atom formulas \(A,B\) and a classical proof \(h\) of \(\{A\}\vdash B\), let \(J\) be the native reading of the precise middle formula returned by the specified analytic-search and extraction procedure. Then \(\{A\}\vdash J\), \(\{J\}\vdash B\), and \(\operatorname{at}(J)\subseteq\operatorname{at}(A)\cap\operatorname{at}(B)\).
